admission.justification: Keeps the current mounted continuation from replacing a coherent selected review on an adverse or later page. The retained W03 origin/log is historical; current source explicitly compares judgment rather than the removed evidence channel. This bounded scope prevents claiming old collection preservation from the new pane.

applicability: Late source expressions in the family read cycle.
conditions: Selected intent, the current recorded judgment, siblings, focus, inline layout and explicitly open files are preserved while every captured late expression becomes reachable.
The first reachable card is explicitly collapsed/reopened so continuation preservation is real.

The current source waits for the selected revision identifiers and compares the rendered statement across the walk; it no longer independently asserts both literal statement operands as the old case did.
exclusions: Freezing text before the editor is awaited; vacuous open-state claims.

The former supporting evidence/assessment/observation collection is not retained by this contract; the current source compares the judgment pane instead. Historical W03 execution and origin evidence is not a fresh run.

evidence: ports-fifth.log: keeps selected intent, evidence, siblings, focus and open layout while a late source expression becomes reachable; assertion-fates.md

statement: Continuations preserve selected statement, the current recorded judgment, siblings, focus, inline layout and an explicitly open file while making every captured late source expression reachable.
